No swap goes out that I have not tasted.\");\n  }\n\n  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n  // Standing corrections\n  //\n  // Issuing a correction used to be a line in the log and one bump of a\n  // counter. These methods are the part that makes it stick: `issueDirective`\n  // puts it in force, `activeDirectives`/`directivesFor` are how the floor and\n  // the graders read what is still in force, and lifting is the only way it\n  // stops.\n  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n  /**\n   * Put a correction in force, or hand back the one already standing over the\n   * same tickets. Saying the same thing twice is one instruction, not two —\n   * otherwise a manager who restated a correction would have to lift it as\n   * many times as they said it.\n   */\n  private issueDirective(input: {\n    category: DirectiveCategory;\n    note: string;\n    orderIds?: readonly string[];\n    roles?: readonly Role[];\n  }): StandingDirective {\n    const orderIds = [...(input.orderIds ?? [])];\n    const standing = this.directives.find(\n      (directive) =>\n        isDirectiveInForce(directive) &&\n        directive.category === input.category &&\n        sameDirectiveScope(directive.orderIds, orderIds),\n    );\n    if (standing) return standing;\n\n    const sequence = ++this.directiveCounter;\n    const directive: StandingDirective = {\n      id: `dir-${sequence}`,\n      category: input.category,\n      note: input.note,\n      roles: [...(input.roles ?? DIRECTIVE_ROLES[input.category])],\n      orderIds,\n      issuedAtTick: this.currentState.episode.tick,\n      sequence,\n    };\n    this.directives.push(directive);\n    return directive;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * The tickets a safety correction is scoped to when it is issued. Empty when\n   * no constrained ticket is live — which `directiveCoversOrder` reads as \"the\n   * next one that carries a guest constraint\", so correcting the kitchen early\n   * still binds the ticket that arrives later.\n   */\n  private constrainedOrderIds(): string[] {\n    return this.currentState.orders\n      .filter((order) => order.allergy && ACTIVE_ORDER_STATUSES.has(order.status))\n      .map((order) => order.id);\n  }\n\n  /** Mark one directive lifted, in place, and hand back the lifted copy. */\n  private standDown(directive: StandingDirective): StandingDirective {\n    const lifted: StandingDirective = { ...cloneDirective(directive), liftedAtTick: this.currentState.episode.tick };\n    this.directives[this.directives.indexOf(directive)] = lifted;\n    return lifted;\n  }\n\n  /** Lift every correction in force in one category — reopening the door lifts the hold. */\n  private liftDirectivesInCategory(category: DirectiveCategory): StandingDirective[] {\n    const lifted: StandingDirective[] = [];\n    for (const directive of [...this.directives]) {\n      if (isDirectiveInForce(directive) && directive.category === category) lifted.push(this.standDown(directive));\n    }\n    return lifted;\n  }\n\n  /** Every correction currently in force, in issue order. */\n  activeDirectives(): StandingDirective[] {\n    return this.directives\n      .filter(isDirectiveInForce)\n      .sort((a, b) => a.sequence - b.sequence)\n      .map(cloneDirective);\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * A role's corrections in issue order: what this body is still bound by on\n   * this turn, which is the whole point of a correction that sticks. Pass\n   * `includeLifted` to read the ones that have been stood down as well.\n   */\n  directivesFor(role: Role, options?: { includeLifted?: boolean }): StandingDirective[] {\n    return this.directives\n      .filter((directive) => directiveTargetsRole(directive, role))\n      .filter((directive) => options?.includeLifted === true || isDirectiveInForce(directive))\n      .sort((a, b) => a.sequence - b.sequence)\n      .map(cloneDirective);\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Explicitly lift a standing correction — the only thing that stops one.\n   *\n   * Routed through `stepEnvelope` rather than mutating here, so the lift is\n   * journalled like every other exercise of manager authority: a replay that\n   * dropped it would keep enforcing a correction the recorded run had stood\n   * down, and refuse an action the recorded run accepted.\n   */\n  liftDirective(directiveId: string, note?: string): { accepted: boolean; state: RestaurantState; error?: ActionError } {\n    const directive = this.directives.find((candidate) => candidate.id === directiveId);\n    return this.submitPlayerIntervention({\n      kind: \"lift\",\n      targetRole: directive?.roles[0] ?? \"chef\",\n      directiveId,\n      ...(note ? { text: note } : {}),\n    });\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Did the correction stay inside its scope when the warming shelf later ran\n   * warm?
